source.framework: Keras 1.0.7 + Theano 0.8.0; ported to PyTorch, no file copied

from_source: GMF: element-wise product of user and item embeddings, Dense(1, sigmoid, lecun_uniform)
MLP: concatenated embeddings of size layers[0]/2 each, Dense ReLU layers layers[1:], Dense(1, sigmoid, lecun_uniform)
NeuMF: separate GMF and MLP embeddings, concatenated predictive vectors, one prediction layer
Defaults from parse_args: num_factors 8, layers [64,32,16,8], reg 0, num_neg 4, lr 0.001, batch 256, Adam, 100 epochs
Embeddings ~ N(0, 0.01); Dense hidden layers use the Keras 1 default glorot_uniform, biases 0
get_train_instances: every positive followed by num_neg uniform items that are not positives of the user, resampled every epoch
Binary cross-entropy, shuffled mini-batches, no early stopping; the untrained model is evaluated and kept if no epoch beats it
Pre-training (load_pretrain_model): NeuMF takes GMF and MLP weights, prediction = [0.5 h_gmf, 0.5 h_mlp], bias 0.5 (b_gmf + b_mlp); the optimizer stays the --learner option (default Adam)
local_choices: Positives are the H30 labels (train_y > 0: Coat/Yahoo rating >= 4, KuaiRand is_click); the author treats every observed rating as positive
Observed negatives (rating < 4, no click) are not used directly; they can be drawn as sampled negatives
Model selection uses validation NDCG@5 on the H30 split instead of HR@10 on the leave-one-out test set
Sigmoid moved into BCEWithLogitsLoss; scores used for ranking are logits (same order)
Negatives are drawn with a seeded numpy Generator instead of the global np.random
KuaiRand train_c weights are not used (all ones at the default alpha = 0)
differences_from_paper_text: Paper section 4.1: predictive factor 8 means MLP 32-16-8 with embedding 16; the code default layers [64,32,16,8] gives embedding 32 with 32-16-8. The code is followed
Paper: NeuMF with pre-training is optimised with vanilla SGD; NeuMF.py uses the --learner option (default Adam). The code is followed
Paper tunes batch {128,256,512,1024}, lr {1e-4,5e-4,1e-3,5e-3}, factors {8,16,32,64}; no tuning is run here, the code defaults are used
